name: the-looking-glass-printed-omnishroud-spell-cannot-target-it
notes: The Looking Glass: printed Omnishroud -- an opposing spell cannot target it. The Looking Glass (fln04uv297, REGALIA,ITEM): "Divine Relic, Omnishroud". Omnishroud means "This can't be targeted by activations, materializations, or triggered abilities" (comprehensive rules, Keywords > Omnishroud 1); a spell is a card activation, so an Omnishroud object can't be targeted by spells -- Spellshroud and Omnishroud are redundant with each other (Omnishroud 3a). The engine already applied that to the OMNISHROUD turn effect and Argus, All-Seeing Giant, but printed Omnishroud on these cards was never recognised: HasSpellshroud() only knew a hard-coded card-ID list. Player 2 controls the holder plus a Mirrordepth's Blade; player 1 plays Fracturize ("Target item or weapon becomes a Cleric Fractal phantasia ...", a Spell): the target prompt offers ONLY the Mirrordepth's Blade, answering with the holder is refused (expectFailure) and the legal answer then resolves.

rulesClauses: Omnishroud: this can't be targeted by activations, materializations, or triggered abilities (so not by spells).

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The Looking Glass's printed Omnishroud was not implemented: a spell could target it. HasSpellshroud() (Custom/GameLogic.php) recognised printed Spellshroud only through a hard-coded card-ID list and HasKeyword_Spellshroud(), which is never generated (Data/ProcessKeywordsGA.php has no Spellshroud keyword, so function_exists is false), and fln04uv297 was in neither. Evidence on HEAD 48faaae9 (this fixture, run against the unfixed Custom/GameLogic.php): player 1's spell target prompt was 'MZCHOOSE:theirField-1&theirField-2' -- every holder was offered, and the first refused answer was accepted ('Step 4 unexpectedly succeeded'). Fix: HasSpellshroud() returns true for the printed-Omnishroud card IDs (a spell is an activation, which Omnishroud forbids targeting) after the HasNoAbilities / NO_SPELLSHROUD gates. Break/restore: reverting Custom/GameLogic.php to HEAD~1 (48faaae9) fails this fixture (Step 4 unexpectedly succeeded; this fixture requires rejection); restoring the fix (shasum 0ae48c678ba109f3cbd835f3b409cbd37d44a11c) passes. Full-suite revert: 22 of the 28 new fixtures fail (1011/1033), the 6 negative controls / pins pass either way. Mutation check: renaming only the Looking Glass ID in the Omnishroud entries fails only this fixture (1032/1033).
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php HasSpellshroud() (no entry for fln04uv297; no generated HasKeyword_Spellshroud table)
